## seqeron 0.9.0

A node is now one process: the Replayer runs inside `SequencerServer`. A cluster on several hosts is
configured by a single host list, `SEQERON_HOSTS`, and clients can run on a **gateway host**, one that runs
no member.

The frame schema (`sbe-frame.xml`, 210) and the sequencing logic are unchanged, so an existing cluster's
log replays to the same tap.

### Breaking changes

- **The Replayer runs in the member's JVM.** Remove any `ReplayerServer` process from a member's
  supervisor, start script or container. `ReplayerServer`'s `main` now runs only on a gateway host and
  refuses to start without `replayer.archiveEndpoints` or `SEQERON_HOSTS`. A Replayer duty-cycle failure
  exits the node with 70, and a shutdown that gives up waiting for that duty cycle exits with 71. Both
  mean restart the node. Health checks need only `SequencerServer`'s `Running` line.
- **Java: `blockLength()` and `version()` are 0 on every system frame**, synthesized ones included
  (`LeadershipChanged`, `ClusterHeartbeat`, `GatewayActive`). Wrap every system decoder with its compiled
  constants:
  `decoder.wrap(event.buffer(), event.payloadOffset(), Decoder.BLOCK_LENGTH, Decoder.SCHEMA_VERSION)`.
- **`ReplayerStreamReceiver` requires `onSequenced`**, and the constructor throws without it. A frame
  whose own callback is null (Java) or empty (C++) now arrives in `onSequenced` as a system frame instead
  of being dropped, so `globalSeqNo` has no holes.
- **A shared replay `clientId` is now fatal.** When two processes on a node use one
  `SEQERON_REPLAYER_CLIENT_ID`, the Replayer tells both (spec R-5), and `poll()` and a façade's
  `doWork()` throw: `IllegalStateException` in Java, `std::runtime_error` in C++. Before, both stalled
  silently.

### New

- **`SEQERON_HOSTS`** (`host0,host1,host2`, member `i` on entry `i`), set identically for every seqeron
  process:
  - A member builds Aeron's `clusterMembers` from it, and binds and advertises its own entry.
    `-Dsequencer.hosts` sets the list for one node; combining it with `sequencer.clusterMembers` or
    `sequencer.nodeCount` is refused. `sequencer.baseDir` is required once the list names more than one
    member.
  - Clients' default ingress endpoints (`PortLayout.ingressEndpoints()`, C++
    `protocol::ingressEndpointsCsv()`), `clusterctl`'s ingress endpoints and egress host, `ClusterProbe`,
    and a gateway host's archive endpoints follow from it.
  - `PortLayout.parseHosts` and `ingressEndpoints(List)` (C++ `parseHosts`, `ingressEndpointsCsv(hosts)`)
    build an endpoint set from any other list.
- **Gateway hosts.** `start-gateway-host.sh` runs `ReplayerServer` with its own media driver and archive,
  and relays a member's tap onto the host's own over UDP, moving to the next member when that one is
  lost. `Gateway` and consumers there run unchanged, with the host's node id (3 or above) in place of a
  member id. Members must be able to reach ephemeral UDP ports on the host
  (`doc/fault-tolerance.md` §3.3, `doc/ops.md`).
- **`Application` off the cluster.** `offCluster(true)` (C++ `Config::offCluster`) runs an `Application`
  on a gateway host. Its gate opens once caught up, whoever leads, and ingress is UDP only. Run exactly
  one instance, since nothing elects between two; use a `Gateway` when you need a standby.
- **C++ producers can reach a cluster on other hosts.** `ClusterStreamSender::connect`/`connectColocated`
  and `Application`/`Gateway`'s `Config::ingressEndpoints` take the endpoint set, defaulting as above.
  The sender dials every member at once and follows a follower's redirect to the leader. Before, it
  dialled member 0 on `localhost` only.
- **C++ `LifecycleEvent` carries its payload.** `decodeSystem<ConnectionOpened>(event)` reads
  `connectionData`, which was reachable only from Java before.
- **Replay protocol:** `ReplayClientIdInUse` (template 22) is added to `sbe-replay.xml` (212) in place.
- **`doc/getting-started.md`**: a release node, a consumer and a producer.

### Upgrading

- Upgrade a node and its co-located clients together, since the replay schema gained a message.
- On a multi-host cluster, replace `-Dsequencer.clusterMembers=…` with `SEQERON_HOSTS` and set
  `sequencer.baseDir` to persistent storage. `clusterMembers` still works on its own.
- Drop `CLUSTERCTL_INGRESS_ENDPOINTS` and `CLUSTERCTL_EGRESS_HOST` where `SEQERON_HOSTS` now supplies
  them.
